tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and slide ground: mist by day, forest night in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tables and dashboard panels on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells, chart plot areas, input fields on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: Deep forest bands: research banners, section dividers, slide chapter covers. Text on it is `on-deep`.

tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: Frosted card laid over forest photography (the flyer card). Text on it uses `ink` and `ink-body`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and key text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `frost`. The brand writes headlines in bark brown, not black.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Running text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `frost`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, footers, secondary lines on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Forest green from the logo. Logo, rules, icon circles' ink, big date figures, chart primary series. As text only at 24px+ or bold 19px+ in light.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Green text at any size (pillar labels, links, small dates) on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `frost`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brand` fill (the green pill button).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Pillar icon circles and soft graphic fields. Never a text color.

tokens.name: sage-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted panels, highlighted table rows, chart secondary areas.

tokens.name: bark
tokens.usage: Primary call to action: the brown registration pill. Text on it is `on-bark`.

tokens.name: on-bark
tokens.usage: Text on a `bark` fill.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-deep`.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Sunlit leaf highlight: one accent stroke, a chart's highlighted value, a motion sparkle. Use sparingly, never for text on light grounds.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Card borders, table dividers on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The green double rule that frames the date line.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid, offset 2px.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Research improvement, goal met. Always paired with a word or arrow.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Data needing attention. Always paired with a word or icon.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Poster and slide titles, one per frame. `ink` on light grounds, `on-deep` on `surface-deep`.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: מפגש ייחודי למנהלות ומנהלי משאבי אנוש
styles.usage: Section headings, sub-headlines under a display line. Often weight 500 on flyers (set `font-weight:500`).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, speaker names, dashboard panel titles.

styles.name: date
styles.usage: The event date line between two `rule` lines. `brand` on light grounds.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big research numbers in dashboards and data slides. Tabular figures.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: אנחנו מזמינים אתכם למפגש בוקר חווייתי בטבע, בו תכירו את רפואת היער.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: גישה מבוססת מחקר המחברת בין טבע, בריאות ורווחה.
styles.usage: Running text. Bold (700) for the brand name inside a sentence.

styles.name: body-light
styles.sample: מומחית למנהיגות וניהול בעולם של הפרעה
styles.usage: Speaker subtitles and the flyer's airy secondary lines.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: בריאות טובה יותר | אנשים מחוברים יותר | ארגונים חיים יותר
styles.usage: Footer taglines, sources under charts, captions. `ink-muted`.
